# connect.md

> A browser-only Vercel site for building portable professional profiles and resumes as Markdown.

- Guided builder: /human
- Direct Markdown editor: /md
- Agent drafting runbook: /agent-readme.md
- Privacy and data boundary: /trust

Existing `.md` files can be opened locally in either editor. Drafts remain in the current browser session and are downloaded locally. The site has no publishing API, account, database, messaging system, or agent credential.
